question: Which DRDO lab in Pune developed the 6.8 times 43 mm assault rifle prototype?

options.text: The Armament Research and Development Establishment (ARDE)
The Armament Exploration and Innovation Establishment (AEIE)

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Armament Research and Development Establishment (ARDE)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Armament Research and Development Establishment (ARDE)**, located in Pune, is a premier laboratory of the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO), India**. It focuses on the research and development of armament systems.
 
• The **6.8 × 43 mm assault rifle prototype** was developed by ARDE as part of India's initiative to modernize its small arms for the armed forces. This development is a key step toward achieving **self-reliance in defence technology**.
 
• The 6.8 × 43 mm caliber was selected due to its **balance between stopping power, range, and recoil**, making it suitable for both close-quarters and mid-range combat scenarios.
 
• ARDE has a history of developing advanced armament systems, including **small arms, artillery, and missile systems**. The assault rifle prototype is an example of their expertise in designing state-of-the-art weaponry.
 
• Such indigenous developments help reduce reliance on foreign arms imports, aligning with the Indian government’s **"Make in India"** initiative in the defence sector.<
